description: The closed list of bases an evidence edge may give for lowering a VDR factor (likely_exploitable, internet_reachable). The nine keys and their wording are the justification values of the CycloneDX 1.6 vulnerability analysis (impactAnalysisJustification), read from the CycloneDX specification repository on 2026-10-16. They were written for 'not affected' and fit these two factors; bases for lowering pain are not yet specified and are deliberately absent (req-fedramp-20x-vdr-evidence-6). The enum on the edge definition CITES_FACTOR_EVIDENCE__fedramp_20x_vdr is the enforced copy of these keys; a test fails if the two differ.
